notice: After Director permission, FIR-001 through FIR-003 were sequentially downloaded to git-ignored, non-public local storage for controlled intake. FIR-001 and FIR-002 were rejected. FIR-003 passed preliminary intake, but the Director abandoned the free/open image library initiative before any derivative or approval was created. FIR-004 and FIR-005 were abandoned before complete intake. No candidate is approved.

policies.capturedStatement: You are welcome to use any images with the label ‘CC0 Public Domain Designation’ for any purpose, including commercial and noncommercial uses, free of charge and without additional permission from the museum.
policies.qualification: The page states that identifying and obtaining necessary third-party permissions is the user's responsibility and requests an artist/title/date/institution caption.

policies.capturedStatement: You are welcome to use any images or data with the label ‘CC0 Public Domain Designation,’ or otherwise stated as made available by AIC under the CC0 license, for any purpose, including commercial and noncommercial uses, without additional permission from AIC.
policies.qualification: The terms reserve third-party rights and separately control AIC trademarks including its logo, lion statues and building image.

policies.capturedStatement: CC0 is intended to allow a work to be copied, modified, incorporated in other works, reused and redistributed as freely as possible in any form and for any purposes, including commercial purposes.
policies.qualification: CC0 does not grant patent or trademark rights and does not waive or affect privacy, publicity or other persons' rights beyond the affirmer's authority.

policies.capturedStatement: The policy says much collection information and data can be freely used, including commercially and without permission, where an exact Public Domain or CC0 notice applies.
policies.qualification: Some exact items instead use CC BY 4.0 or are not freely available. The museum requests source credit even where not required.

policies.capturedStatement: Many high-resolution images identified in the Open Content Program are available under CC0; no Getty permission is required and they may be used for any purpose.
policies.qualification: No implied Getty endorsement is allowed and Getty does not warrant that all open-content images are free of third-party rights.

policies.capturedStatement: The Met makes its selected collection dataset available for unrestricted commercial and noncommercial use under CC0 and states that companion artworks covered by its policy are identified with a CC0 icon.
policies.qualification: This repository statement does not replace a retained current image-policy and exact object-page capture. The Met image-policy pages returned HTTP 429 during this research.

apiMetadata.title: Botanical Specimen
apiMetadata.creditLine: Edward E. Ayer Endowment in memory of Charles L. Hutchinson

imageAcquisition.storageQualification: The .tmp path is git-ignored and non-public but is not durable controlled storage.

intakeDecision.reason: Full-resolution inspection found the plant specimen extremely faint and indistinct, with uneven aged paper, mount corners, stains, specks and no clean separable edges. A useful garment asset would require interpretive restoration or tracing and could introduce inaccurate botanical detail.

intakeDecision.reason: The flowers and vase are difficult to distinguish within a dense dark crayon field. Mounting paper, corner mounts, edge wear and pencil marks surround the work. Cropping does not resolve garment-scale clarity, while separation or tracing would require interpretive reconstruction.
